purpose: Cross-validate author-work keyword and rune-intent analysis with a simple governed rule engine and an API semantic engine without changing current statistics copy or production ranking presentation.

exclude_for_now: Threads corpus outside selected author works

classification_model.rule: Author classification and semantic intent are separate dimensions and must not overwrite each other.

method: Compare the work or supplied text directly against current rune principles.
Allow finite oscillation only among directly plausible neighboring principles.
Choose by direct semantic focus, not by character matching.
Do not follow extended-association chains from a word to a possible consequence.
Do not infer a rune merely from a rune character occurring inside a phrase.
Recurring errors should trigger principle review rather than accumulating one-off exceptions.

api_semantic_engine.role: Independent semantic observer for keyword/theme/rune-intent candidates.
constraints: Must not rewrite Base66 or Current Canon.
Must preserve lo3rwang-specific named concepts as named concepts.
Must report direct semantic evidence instead of free associative interpretation.
Output is compared with the basic engine rather than automatically replacing it.

cross_validation.agreement: The two engines converge on the same primary rune/group intent under the same scope.
cross_validation.disputed: Both have plausible but different direct-semantic candidates; retain both for governance review.
cross_validation.unresolved: Evidence is insufficient for a stable result.
cross_validation.governance_rule: Disputes are calibration evidence. Do not patch individual outputs unless the issue is truly a scope-limited named-concept ownership rule.

author_keyword_rules.rule: Author ownership is 德; the phrase is not decomposed into 月/光 for author classification. Its direct visual semantic intent can still be 光.
Author-named concept; do not classify by decomposing 人生 or 月台.
This ownership applies to lo3rwang author-derived governance vocabulary and is not a universal Chinese semantic rule.
Directly a form of light; do not extend to 塵、福 or 星 from secondary associations.

boundary_examples.text: 遲到／延誤／錯過適合時機
boundary_examples.reason: missed timing/opportunity rather than time itself
